• Build repeatable workflows for model training, validation, promotion, deployment and retraining.
• Productionise models through packaging, versioning, model registry integration, deployment automation and safe rollback.
• Design CI/CD pipelines for ML systems, including automated testing, validation, release controls and environment promotion.
• Manage experiment tracking, model metadata and reproducibility across research and production.
• Build reusable tooling and platform capabilities that support multiple models and engineering teams.
Model serving and observability
• Deploy and operate batch and online inference services in containerised cloud environments.
• Define and meet availability, latency, throughput and recovery objectives for ML services.
• Monitor service health, infrastructure, data-quality signals, data drift, prediction drift and model performance decay.
• Establish dashboards, alerting and operational runbooks so failures are detected and resolved quickly.
• Support automated or controlled retraining, model promotion, rollback and model retirement.
• Debug production issues across model, application, infrastructure and critical data-dependency layers.
Reliability, security and engineering quality
• Improve system robustness, scalability and cost efficiency through automation, observability and infrastructure as code.
• Write production-grade Python for long-running services, deployment tooling and ML workflows.
• Establish testing, validation, release and incident-management practices for ML systems.
• Collaborate with platform, security and data engineering teams on reliable model inputs, access controls, secrets, resilience and compliance.
• Make explicit trade-offs between research flexibility, delivery speed, operational risk and production stability.
Additional responsibilities
• Maintain personal/professional development to meet the changing demands of the role, including all relevant regulatory and legislative training
• When dealing with all customers, clients or colleagues ensure that we provide a clear, fair and consistent high quality service that presents a professional and positive image of CMC Markets
• Take all reasonable steps to ensure appropriate confidentiality
• Undertake such other duties, training and/or hours of work as may be reasonably required and which are consistent with the general level of responsibility of this role
KEY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• 3–7 years’ professional experience in MLOps, ML platform engineering, ML infrastructure, backend engineering, DevOps or SRE.
• Strong production Python skills, including clean APIs, testing, performance awareness and maintainable services.
• Experience deploying, serving and operating machine-learning models in production environments.
• Practical understanding of the ML lifecycle, including training, validation, inference, model release, monitoring and retraining.
• Experience designing CI/CD workflows and release processes for ML or other production software systems.
• Hands-on experience with at least one workflow or orchestration system used for ML training, validation or deployment.
• Comfort working with cloud infrastructure, containers, infrastructure as code and service networking.
• Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, alerting, incident response and common failure modes in ML systems.
• Ability to reason about system design, reliability and operational trade-offs—not just individual tools.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with research, engineering, platform, security and product teams.
Nice to have
• Prior ownership of model monitoring, drift detection or automated retraining.
• Familiarity with model registries, feature stores and offline/online feature-consistency challenges.
• Experience supporting multiple models, services or teams on a shared ML platform.
• Exposure to regulated or high-reliability production environments.
• Experience with PyTorch or similar ML frameworks and model-serving technologies.
Technology environment
Language: Python
ML tooling: PyTorch or similar frameworks, experiment tracking and model registries
Workflow orchestration: ML workflows for training, validation, deployment and retraining
Deployment: Containers, model-serving frameworks and infrastructure as code
Observability: Metrics, logging, tracing, alerting and monitoring across model, service and platform layers
Cloud: Managed compute, storage and networking, with a provider-agnostic mindset
The technology stack will evolve. We value engineers who understand why systems are designed in particular ways and can adapt as requirements and tools change.
Why this role matters
Machine-learning models only create value when they are correct, observable and dependable in production. This role is responsible for making that happen.
You’ll reduce the gap between promising experiments and production systems that can be trusted by downstream products and customers. Your work will improve the reliability, speed and scalability of the ML platform across the organisation.
If you care about operational clarity, robust engineering and building ML systems that do not silently fail, this role gives you direct leverage over the success of our machine-learning capabilities.

KBR is a global provider of differentiated, professional services and technologies delivered across a wide government, defense and industrial base. Senior Counsel, Legal – AI Governance, Data Privacy, & Cybersecurity
As the Senior Counsel, Legal – AI Governance, Data Privacy, & Cybersecurity, you will serve as the legal lead and manage the legal side of these programs for a global company operating in multiple jurisdictions. In this role, you will report to the Vice President, Legal – Litigation & Compliance
AI Governance – you will maintain a global AI Governance program and advise on AI-specific laws (such as the EU AI Act) as well as AI Governance generally, providing legal and business advice that is risk-conscious while encouraging responsible AI development and use. You will coordinate a cross-functional team that includes attorneys and cyber risk professionals and maintain an internal website resource that provides guidance and updates.
Data Privacy – you will maintain a global Data Privacy program and advise on data privacy laws (including the GDPR, UK Data Protection Act 2018/UK GDPR, and laws in other jurisdictions such as the US, Saudi Arabia, China, and California). You will provide advice on contracts with vendors and customers, and you will lead the response to data subject requests, coordinating with Human Resources professionals, management, and other attorneys.
Cybersecurity – you will coordinate with the Chief Information Security Office’s team to address legal cybersecurity risk. You will also assist with analysis of data events to determine whether any personal data breach or non-personal data breach reporting requirements, either statutory or contractual, are implicated, working together with other attorneys and stakeholders.
Insider Threat – you will assist in assessing and coordinating responses to potential insider threats and managing the company’s global insider threat program, working with other attorneys, management, and insider threat support professionals from the IT team.
Required Qualifications:
• Law degree and admission to practice in the UK or an EU member state
• A relevant number of years PQE
• Comprehensive expertise in the AI, data privacy and cybersecurity laws of many jurisdictions
• Strong grasp of ISO 27701 or similar data privacy frameworks and working knowledge of adjacent frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001)
• Strong change management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and countries and to design and implement efficient, sustainable processes and tools
• Ability to communicate key issues in simple, succinct ways and to pivot and respond to stakeholders’ questions and challenges
• Ability to raise the understanding of and attention to data privacy throughout large global organizations
• Track record of increasing your effectiveness and productivity through using approved AI systems for work
• Managing outside counsel to deliver value
Additional Relevant Experience
• The ideal candidate will also have a strong grasp of (1) AI laws, including the EU AI Act, and AI governance, and/or (2) information governance, including data mapping and record retention.
• Familiarity with AI-specific laws, AI-related laws, Data Privacy laws, and Cybersecurity laws
• Experience advising clients on business and legal risk in a risk-conscious but business-focused approach
• Motivation and initiative in researching and distilling new laws and laws from various jurisdictions into sound legal and business advice
• Sound judgment and confidence addressing sensitive insider threat situations
• Patience and understanding of cultural differences in a global business environment
Preferred Qualifications:
• CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPP/A, and CIPM certifications from the International Association of Privacy Professionals
• AI Governance Professional (AIGP) certification from the International Association of Privacy Professionals
• Experience with internal investigations, employment law, IP law or litigation

When you become part of the KBR team, your opportunities are endless. Through collaboration with our customers, we’re defining tomorrow’s challenges, then providing the solutions and services to overcome those challenges, always maintaining our commitment to total safety and reliability.
At KBR, we partner with government and industry clients to provide purposeful and comprehensive solutions with an emphasis on efficiency and safety. With a full portfolio of services, proprietary technologies and expertise, our employees are ready to handle projects and missions throughout their entire lifecycle, from planning and design to sustainability and maintenance. Whether at the bottom of the ocean or in outer space, our clients trust us to deliver the impossible on a daily basis.
Working at KBR means being rewarded for your contributions. Security Clearance
At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations.  As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.

Do you want to help us improve human health and understand life on Earth? Make your mark by shaping the future to enable or deliver life-changing science to solve some of humanity’s greatest challenges.
We are seeking a highly motivated and creative Postdoctoral Fellow to join the Martin group at the Wellcome Sanger Institute, working towards understanding the genetic basis of early-life traits and conditions, and/or to develop biomarkers for pregnancy complications and neonatal diseases.
About the Group:
The Martin group works on the genetic basis of rare and common disease, using large-scale human genetic datasets with rich linkage to electronic health records and questionnaires. Over the last few years, we have had a particular emphasis on the genetics of neurodevelopmental disorders and related traits, the genetics of complex disease in populations with high levels of consanguinity, and factors influencing germline mutation rates. Recent work from the group has appeared in Nature, Cell, Nature Genetics, and Nature Human Behavior. A full list of our recent papers can be found here: https://www.sanger.ac.uk/group/martin-group/. The group is now opening new research directions involving genomics and multi-omics in very early life. Most conditions in the earliest stages of life remain untouched by large-scale genomics, and molecular predictors that could guide clinical management are urgently needed. We are building a programme spanning a clinical continuum from pregnancy loss, through fetal growth restriction, to complications of premature birth. This includes large-scale sequencing of birth cohorts to study the genetic basis of perinatal and early-life traits and conditions, genetic and multi-omic studies of neonatal conditions using nationwide Scandinavian dried blood spots, and large-scale sequencing of cell-free DNA (cfDNA) from pregnant mothers.
What you'll be doing:
We are seeking a highly motivated postdoc to work on one or more of the following projects:
• Analysis of large-scale proteomic data from nationwide Scandinavian dried blood spots, in order to develop biomarkers for understudied neonatal conditions that are common in premature babies. These samples are collected before disease onset and linked to rich registry data, which opens up questions about molecular subtypes, prediction and aetiology that have not previously been tractable. There may also be the opportunity to analyse largescale genetic datasets from these same blood spots, to carry out the first well-powered genetic studies of these neonatal conditions.
• Analysis of new sequence and genotype data from over 110,000 individuals across four birth cohorts, including the Norwegian Mother, Father and Child Cohort Study (MoBa), to explore genetic influences on neurodevelopmental and perinatal traits. This is one of the world’s largest family-based sequence datasets. Questions here could include:
• Disentangling direct from indirect genetic effects using new methods. Exploring time-varying effects of genetics using longitudinal phenotype data.
• Exploring the factors influencing penetrance of variants associated with rare neurodevelopmental conditions.
• Studying how genetic architecture of different traits varies across the phenotype distribution.
• Developing biomarkers for pregnancy complications from methylation-aware whole-genome sequence data on cell-free DNA (cfDNA) from pregnant women, including methods development to incorporate both epigenetic and genetic information in the same assay.
Questions here could include:
• Disentangling direct from indirect genetic effects using new methods. Exploring time-varying effects of genetics using longitudinal phenotype data.
• Exploring the factors influencing penetrance of variants associated with rare neurodevelopmental conditions.
• Studying how genetic architecture of different traits varies across the phenotype distribution.
• Developing biomarkers for pregnancy complications from methylation-aware wholegenome sequence data on cell-free DNA (cfDNA) from pregnant women, including methods development to incorporate both epigenetic and genetic information in the same assay.
This project is also listed in the parallel advert for our cfDNA-focused postdoctoral position, and could be taken forward from either post. The project can be tailored around the postdoc's interests and expertise. The work will be done in collaboration with groups in the UK, Scandinavia and elsewhere, as well as with other groups at the Sanger Institute.
About you:
This role would suit someone with experience in statistical analyses of large-scale human genetic or other omic datasets, particularly on DNA sequence data, methylation data and/or with high-throughput proteomic data. You will be based at the Wellcome Sanger Institute on the Wellcome Genome Campus near Cambridge, with access to world-leading sequencing capacity and computational infrastructure, and to a large community of statistical and computational geneticists. You will join the Postdoctoral Fellow community and be able to take part in training, networking opportunities. Prospective candidates are welcome to contact hcm@sanger.ac.uk with informal queries before deciding whether to apply.
Essential Skills:
• PhD in a relevant area (statistics, statistical genetics, genetics, genomics, proteomics, bioinformatics or similar)
• Experience analysing large-scale high-throughput human genetic and/or epigenetic and/or proteomic data, including quality control and normalization where relevant
• Knowledge of statistical methods appropriate for large-scale omics research
• Full working proficiency in Python and/or R, and Unix/Linux
• Experience or enthusiasm for using AI tools to improve productivity in scientific research
• Previous experience writing highly reproducible code with github, Snakemake/Nextflow, RMarkdown or similar
• Creativity and original scientific ideas
• Enthusiasm and commitment
• Attention to detail
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Ability to communicate ideas and results effectively both verbally and in writing
• Ability to prioritise, work independently and organise own workload
• Ability to collaborate effectively with and independently supervise less experienced scientists

Mattioli Woods is looking for a seasoned security leader to take ownership of information and cyber security across the Group. The Group operates in an FCA-regulated environment, continues to grow through acquisition, and is actively adopting AI, data and automation across its operations. • Ensure security is embedded into the future enterprise architecture and technology change lifecycle, working closely with Enterprise Architecture and technology teams

What we're looking for
• Proven experience as a security leader, combining strong risk judgement with hands-on delivery capability

Our Team
Semtech's New Product Introduction (NPI) Product Engineering Team is the central engineering function behind every new product we bring to market. Our team of focused and talented engineers takes full ownership of new product development — driving each program from conception through end-of-life with a commitment to flawless execution. Working closely with all internal cross-functional teams, our engineers define and drive DfT testability requirements, test coverage, production characterization (across process, voltage, and temperature variations), ATE-to-bench correlation, cost and yield optimization, test time reduction, project logistics, and seamless transfer to full-volume manufacturing.  We take pride in delivering high-quality products that exceed customer expectations and drive business success — and our versatile, results-driven team makes it happen.
Job Summary
We are currently looking for a Sr. NPI Product Engineer to join our team. This role sits at the heart of new product development — engaged from product concept through end-of-life — collaborating closely with all internal cross-functional teams to drive program success. This is a unique opportunity for a passionate and driven engineer to influence key engineering and product decisions and make a meaningful impact on the cutting-edge products we deliver to our customers worldwide.
This is an exciting opportunity to work within a world-class NPI development team, focused on designing and developing advanced high-performance analog and mixed-signal semiconductor IC products in cutting-edge CMOS and BiCMOS technologies. Our products are built with purpose and precision — operating at data rates of 25–400Gbps and beyond — delivering faster, more reliable connectivity for AI data centers, PON, and 5G wireless networks. Reporting to the Manager of NPI Product Engineering, the Sr. NPI Product Engineer will take full ownership of all NPI activities — driving and executing from product concept through final product release while maintaining the product life cycle.
Responsibilities
1. NPI Program Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration (25%)
• Lead and drive all NPI activities from product concept through final product release while ensuring product conformance to specifications, and seamless transfer to full-volume manufacturing
• Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams including Project Lead, Design, Marketing, Validation, Test Engineering, Characterization, Quality & Reliability, Applications Engineering and Operations to ensure successful product development and delivery
• Actively participate in the milestone reviews of NPI program logistics, timelines, and milestones, providing regular updates to management and stakeholders
• Prepare all NPI product release and OSAT related manufacturing documentations for production transfer and product maintenance
• Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior product engineers
2. Design for Testability/Manufacturability (35%)
• Lead team to define Design for Manufacturability (DfM) and Design for Testability (DfT) requirements for NPI products and provide feedback to design for implementation to ensure comprehensive and efficient production test coverage
• Support test engineers in the development, implementation, verification and optimization of ATE test programs ensuring the testability/manufacturability features are considered and implemented, and that test coverage and quality is achieved while maintaining accurate cost models
• Lead product characterization, correlation and release activities, ensuring all datasheet specifications are validated and met
3. Characterization, Data Analysis & Yield Optimization (30%)
• Develop comprehensive product characterization plans encompassing both wafer-level and bench characterization tests, ensuring thorough test coverage across all product specifications and operating conditions
• Conduct rigorous data analysis of ATE and bench characterization results across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations, including ATE-to-bench correlation studies, PCM data analysis, process capability analysis to ensure product conformance to specifications and yield modeling for new products
• Plan and execute Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize product performance, drive yield analysis, test time reduction, and test optimization efforts — identifying and resolving yield limiters in close collaboration with Design, Test, Quality, and Foundry Process teams
• Contribute to product validation and reliability qualification plans working closely with Test, Characterization, Validation, and Reliability Engineering teams to ensure alignment and successful execution
4. Manufacturing Quality, Failure Analysis & Continuous Improvement (10%)
• Work with foundry process/packaging engineering in the resolution of problems that occur during wafer fabrication, packaging, die sort and final package test processes
• Drive the resolution of failure analysis, root cause and corrective actions for field returns
• Monitor and maintain product life cycle, identifying opportunities for cost reduction and continuous improvement
Minimum Qualifications:
• BSc in Electrical Engineering or related field and a minimum of 8 years relevant work experience.
• Experience in semi-conductor technology, product, test and/or design engineering.
• Experience with quality systems including corrective actions, 8D reports, non-conformance reports, and failure analysis reports.
• Knowledge and experience with statistical theory and data analysis tools (e.g. Excel, JMP, Galaxy, dataConductor) for design of experiments, yield reporting and modelling.
• Experience in high-speed digital ATE test platforms (e.g. Advantest, Teradyne) or equivalent rack solutions is an asset.
• Strong knowledge of high-speed serial digital interconnect components and test methodologies
• Experience with JEDEC, and/or Mil quality requirements.

Job Description:
Job title: Postdoctoral Fellow – S Boulton lab
Reporting to: Simon J. Boulton, Principal Group Leader
Contract term: This is a full-time, fixed term (4 year) position on Crick terms and conditions of employment.
The Research Group
Our research is focused on understanding the mechanisms that preserve genome stability, with emphasis on DNA double strand break (DSB) repair, the response to replication stress and the maintenance and protection of telomeres. Our work exploits a combination of genetics, functional genomics, proteomics, biochemistry and single molecule biophysics, which has allowed us to discover novel DNA repair genes and provide molecular insights into human diseases, including cancer, and disorders caused by telomere or replisome dysfunction. Most notably, our work has played an instrumental role in shaping our understanding of the regulation and execution of homologous recombination (HR), a key DSB repair pathway frequently inactivated in cancer, how the ends of chromosomes (telomeres) are protected from mis-repair, and more recently how cells sense and tolerate replication stress. This post is funded by a Wellcome Discovery Award to investigate the function and regulation of SLFN11 in replication stress tolerance, cancer development and therapy resistance.
Project summary
The tRNA nuclease SLFN11 is epigenetically silenced in approximately half of all treatment-naive tumours and is the single strongest predictor of resistance to DNA damaging chemotherapy. In response to replication stress, SLFN11 is activated and cleaves type II Leu-tRNAs, triggering translation shutdown and p53-independent apoptosis. Because this silencing is already present before treatment, chemoresistance cannot be the selective pressure that drives it, and why SLFN11 is lost so frequently during tumour evolution is unknown. We have recently implicated SLFN11 in sensing telomeric single-stranded DNA and eliminating ATRX-deficient cells during telomere crisis, such that loss of SLFN11 permits the emergence of survivors that establish alternative lengthening of telomeres (Segura-Bayona et al.). Analysis of DepMap data further associates SLFN11 loss with MYC over-expression and with damaging mutations in ARID1A, SMARCA4 and MSH6. These observations lead to the hypothesis, as yet untested, that SLFN11 loss is selected early in tumour evolution as a means of tolerating endogenous replication stress generated by oncogene activation and other transforming events.
The aim of this project is to test that hypothesis directly in primary human cells. The post holder will use primary cells with a finite replicative lifespan and remain contact-inhibited to ask whether oncogenic (Myc, Ras) and mutational events (p53, Rb, PP2A) select for the loss of SLFN11. The work will involve engineering cells with the aforementioned oncogenic drivers and mutations, and then determining whether these alterations towards cellular transformation activate SLFN11 using the lab's GFP (TTA codon) reporter of tRNA nuclease activity together with markers of the integrated stress response and apoptosis, and establishing whether replication stress and RPA exhaustion accompany activation. The consequences of SLFN11 loss for mutational processes and genome rearrangement will be assessed by whole-genome sequencing in collaboration with Serena Nik-Zainal (Cambridge), with access to the Crick Advanced Sequencing, Bioinformatics and High Throughput Screening STPs.
In this project, some of the specific aims could include but not be limited to:
• Engineering and characterising primary cells models of oncogenic activating and tumour suppressor mutations.
• Determining whether these transforming events activate SLFN11 and whether this is accompanied by replication stress and RPA exhaustion
• Testing whether these events selective for loss of SLFN11 during cellular transformation
• Defining the consequences of SLFN11 loss for transformation, replication dynamics and mutational processes.
Postdoctoral Fellows are expected to lead their own projects, contribute to other projects on a collaborative basis (both in the lab and with external collaborators) and guide PhD students in their research. The ability to work in a team is essential.
Key experience and competencies
The post holder should embody and demonstrate our core Crick values: bold, open, collegial, in addition to the following:
Essential
• PhD in molecular/cell biology, cancer biology, genome stability or a related discipline, or in the final stages of PhD submission
• Prior knowledge and experience in the study of genome stability, the DNA damage response, replication stress and/or oncogene-induced transformation
• Technical expertise in primary mammalian cell culture and models of cellular transformation.
• Experience of quantitative, image-based assays (immunofluorescence, confocal and/or high-content microscopy), live-cell imaging and flow cytometry
• Track record of writing papers as evidenced by publications or submitted manuscripts in referred journals
• Evidence of data presentation at scientific meetings
• Experience of experimental design, including the planning and execution of long-term experiments
• Ability to work independently and also capable of interacting within a group
Desirable
• Experience of long-term culture, senescence, clonal evolution or cellular transformation assays
• Experience of epigenetic analysis, including DNA methylation at silenced loci
• Familiarity with the analysis of whole-genome sequencing data and mutational signatures, or with scripting in R or Python
• Experience of cells biology or of assays for replication dynamics
About Us
At the Crick, we conduct research at the forefront of biomedical research. We combine rigour with an open and collaborative culture, and are outward-looking, reflecting our status as a partnership of six organisations aiming to pool knowledge, ideas and resources.
We have a wide research portfolio with no divisions or departments, bringing biomedical researchers together with clinicians, physical scientists and applied scientists from our pharmaceutical partners.
We aim to attract the most talented researchers and support them to tackle innovative research questions. Our science technology platforms provide our researchers with access to state-of-the-art technology and expertise.
We provide an excellent learning environment with dedicated education programmes in public engagement with science, education and personal development, and a postdoc training programme that prepares scientists for leadership roles in science.

OVERVIEW
Hichrom ACE® Analytical Chromatography, part of Avantor, has been firmly established in the field of chromatography for over 30 years.  The manufacturing and R&D sites operate laboratories specialising in the development, manufacture and supply of high-quality chromatography products, servicing global markets in the Life Sciences and other market segments. The ACE® brand has built a strong reputation amongst chromatographers for product performance, technical expertise, speed of delivery and competitive pricing within the analytical chromatography space.

Responsible for delivering routine maintenance of laboratory instrumentation, with a strong emphasis on HPLC and UHPLC systems, ensuring equipment is fit for purpose across both Manufacturing and R&D laboratories. Maintenance activities are performed on a planned schedule to minimise downtime and maximise instrument availability.
The role also requires prompt response to reactive maintenance requests for general laboratory equipment and instruments, providing timely and effective repair solutions to reduce operational disruption.
All maintenance, repair, and asset records are managed within asset management systems to maintain compliance with ISO 9001 requirements.
Adherence to all site Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) standards is mandatory.
MAJOR JOB DUTIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES (KPIs)
Typical responsibilities may include:
·         Own routine and reactive maintenance of HPLC and uHPLC systems across laboratory areas, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and compliance with quality and regulatory standards. Progress toward qualification for instrument calibration in alignment with validated procedures.

·         Prioritise maintenance interventions based on production demand, equipment criticality, and risk, ensuring maximum uptime and continuity of manufacturing activities.
·         Maintain accurate and traceable service records, updating asset management systems and supporting lifecycle management, including replacement justification for end-of-life or irreparably failed equipment.
·         Monitor and analyse equipment performance and downtime trends, identify root causes of recurring issues, and implement or recommend robust technical and process improvements.

• Collaborate with laboratory and production managers to optimise instrument utilisation, improve workflow efficiency, and support capacity planning.
• Ensure full compliance with company procedures and environmental regulations, including WEEE requirements for the safe disposal and decommissioning of equipment.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and undertake additional responsibilities as required to support laboratory operations and business objectives.

•       Minimum 3 years’ experience repairing Laboratory equipment and instrumentation, specifically HPLC instrumentation

• Excellent record keeping in compliance with ISO 9001 for maintenance records
• Experience or awareness of ISO 17025
• Experience with chromatography instrumentation; including Buchi, Amino Acid Analysers, Mass Spec,
• An awareness of COSHH, PUWER and Task Based or Dynamic Risk Assessments
• Good awareness of chemical safety, chemical storage, and segregation
• Competence in asset management software
• Knowledge in electronic measurement, science and statistics
• Fully versed in Manual Handling techniques
•       Strong fault-finding ability and inquisitive mindset
• Ability to remain calm while under pressure
• Ability to self-motivate and manage own time effectively
• undefined

This role is a hybrid of laboratory and workshop based; suitable PPE equipment and training will be provided for Laboratory presence.
Some physical effort is required through walking, standing, bending, reaching, lifting, or carrying objects that can weigh 20kg. Some degree of lifting and heavy work is likely with the daily movement of equipment, machinery, and supplies.

The Product Manager is responsible for the product vision through to implementation alongside our development teams. They will work with business development teams to identify product-market fit, engage with prospects and customers to deeply understand the problems they have and how we can help solve these problems. They will become the expert on how clients use the product and evangelise their products internally and with clients. They will use client feedback, metrics and research to identify and prioritise opportunities for delivering enhancements and new product ideas.
Based on the wider product strategy and input from commercial and technical teams, the Product Manager will define a long-term vision for the product, convey this to the wider business, and propose new initiatives to grow the value proposition of their products while at the same time making meaningful progress towards their longer term vision for the product or products.
Once the vision is defined; the Product Manager will play a crucial part in product delivery. They will fulfil the product owner role within one or more agile delivery teams, creating a shared understanding of client needs. They will define the priorities and clear acceptance criteria for designing and implementing new features and improvements. • Customer engagement: The Product Manager is expected to build client relationships to facilitate idea generation and be the expert on how the clients use the system, understand their requirements and become the voice of the customer internally. Skills & Experience

• A solid understanding of what data is important to trading firms (and more crucially what is not) especially in the energy trading space
• Able to demonstrate a keen understanding how how trading firms leverage agentic AI at present

• Making decisions based on qualitative and quantitative insights

Personal Attributes

• Driven, client-centric and outcome-focused
• Naturally curious, always seeking new knowledge
• Proactive self-starter
• Creative and resourceful problem solver

Cytokinetics is a specialty cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, building on its over 25 years of pioneering scientific innovations in muscle biology, and advancing a pipeline of potential new medicines for patients suffering from diseases of cardiac muscle dysfunction.
At Cytokinetics, each team member plays an integral part in advancing our mission to improve the lives of patients. We are seeking tenacious, compassionate, and collaborative individuals who are driven to make a positive impact.
Reporting to the Senior Medical Director for the UK, Ireland and Nordics the Senior Medical Science Liaison (Snr MSL) is a scientific professional who serves as a key field-based scientific resource for healthcare providers, patients, industry partners and internal colleagues. This role will come with high visibility in our company including critical cross-functional relationships across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development / Operations, and Commercial.  This role will focus on key opinion leaders and other HCP’s in the hypertrophic cardiomyopathy therapeutic area, but also support pipeline products in development.
Our passion is anchored in rigorous and diligent scientific and clinical approaches to the discovery and development of novel mechanism therapeutics. With gratitude for the commitments and convictions of our employees who are inspired by the courage of patients we aim to serve, we believe Cytokinetics will continue to be a pioneering, values-driven, sustainable, fully integrated biopharmaceutical company.
Key Duties and Responsibilities:
• Identify national, regional, and local Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) involved in the provision of cardiovascular care within institutional care centres and engage them in proactive and reactive scientific exchange
• Maintain and broaden professional relationships with HCPs (Physicians, Specialist Nurses, Echocardiologists, Genetic Counsellors, Pharmacists (and other relevant members of the multi-disciplinary team) in institutional care centers, to expand research, advisory, and educational partnership opportunities; identify areas of unmet medical need; and assure thoughtful exchange of current medical information related to products in development and therapeutic areas of importance
• Serve as a scientific expert at key medical and scientific conferences, advisory boards, clinical investigator meetings, internal meetings, and patient advocacy group meetings
• Maintain a high-level of scientific knowledge and understanding about disease state, underlying science, treatment guidelines, available treatment agents and options, as well as other relevant therapies under development
• Maintain a superior understanding of current trends in clinical research, competitive developments, patient care, and their impact on Cytokinetics’ medical strategies
• Work with Medical Affairs and other internal colleagues on initiatives including medical information, publications, medical education, grants, speaker training, and other educational programs
• Provide support to our clinical development programs by serving as a key point of contact for company-sponsored trial investigators, investigator-initiated research, and registries consistent with company objectives and regulations
• Generate Field Medical Affairs plans to identify collaborative opportunities with KOL’s and institutions, review scientific program of relevant conferences, attend sessions, support exhibit booth operations, and contribute to a timely written conference report summarizing key information, activities, and competitive intelligence to colleagues
• Accurate and timely documentation of activities within applicable company databases and platforms
• Mentor, train and support other Medical Scientists
• Provide scientific training on key relevant data to Key Account Managers and other business colleagues as required
• Provide strategic input and execute region-specific plans to achieve KOL engagement goals and Medical Affairs departmental goals
• Pursue projects independently with a high degree of quality and timely execution
• Contribute to / lead Congress Planning activities
• Maintain a complete awareness of and understanding about current “real world” clinical practices, HEOR drivers, and emerging trends in treatments/medicine
• Establish relationships with key executive leadership colleagues across Cytokinetics and connect external parties with appropriate leadership team members
Qualifications, Knowledge and Skills Required:
• Advanced clinical or scientific degree (BSc, MSc, BPharm, MPharm, PhD, BM BS or equivalent) preferred
• Minimum of 5 years of MSL experience for Snr. MSL.  Cardiovascular therapy area experience is strongly preferred, with direct experience in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy considered a significant advantage. Experience in heart failure is beneficial. The ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities across field, internal, and congress activities is essential
• Must communicate with clarity and precision; able to distil complex scientific data into concise, high-impact exchanges with busy clinicians. Comfortable operating in time-constrained clinical environments where brevity is valued as much as depth. Calling all operational & compliance professionals!
• Can you help us in our ambition of delivering a game changing 5-star service for our customers?
• Do you possess the drive, ambition and experience to be come and show us how to be better than we are today?
• And are you looking for a workplace whereby you can be happy, looked after and your contributions make a real difference?
Then we want to hear from you!
Here at Arriva Road Transport Services, we shine brightest in our service provision, and we exist to prove alternative transport can be better than the journey it replaces. We are going places - literally! We deliver over 80,000 rail replacement journeys, facilitate 20,000 taxi journeys and supply dedicated frontline support to our customers every year.
We have a plan to build on our success so far and have an opening in a key role in operational compliance and want someone to join us, who will drive us forward in every way possible. If you have the skills, knowledge and demonstratable experience for any of the role, we would be extremely happy to receive your application.
Purpose of role:
To be responsible for the operational delivery of ARTS’ compliance and audit activities through leadership of the Compliance Team. Ownership of day-to-day supplier and internal audit delivery, manages the compliance administration workload, and ensures findings are followed through to closure.
Additionally, the creation, management and ownership of business information/data that provides operational assurance that ARTS and its supplier network are meeting their contractual, regulatory and quality obligations — using modern digital and AI-assisted methods as the default.
Direct responsibilities include:
• Audit programme delivery. Plan, schedule and deliver the approved ARTS audit programme — supplier audits, operational audits and compliance checks — on a risk-based cycle, to agreed timescales and to evidence-ready standards.
• Quality assurance. Run the QA routine over ARTS’ compliance activities and supplier outputs, ensuring audit working papers, permit records and compliance documentation are consistent, traceable and fit for external scrutiny.
• Line management of the compliance team. Lead two Lead Auditors, the Taxi Permit Administrator and the Compliance Administrator. Set objectives, manage performance, authorise leave, run 1:1s, address capability issues, and develop the team.
• Supplier assurance. Own the operational relationship with audited suppliers, escalating material non-conformances to the Head of Operations and Head of Safety, and ensuring corrective actions are tracked and closed.
• PSVAR and taxi/PHV compliance. Provide oversight of the Taxi Permit Administrator’s workload, ensuring permits, vehicle records and driver documentation are current, and PSVAR obligations are evidenced on rail replacement services.
• Findings closure and CAPA. Maintain the corrective and preventative action (CAPA) log, chase findings owners, verify closure evidence and escalate overdue or recurring issues.
• Reporting cadence. Produce and own the weekly compliance dashboard and monthly audit pack for operational leadership, highlighting trends, repeat findings and emerging supplier risk — using AI to draft narrative and Power BI to visualise.
• Audit readiness. Support the Head of Safety and external certification bodies during ISO 9001, 45001 and 22301 surveillance audits, presenting the compliance team’s evidence base.
• Digital and AI uplift of the compliance function. Identify, pilot and scale AI-assisted and rules-based improvements to audit templates, findings tracking, supplier evidence collection and MI narrative. Develop the digital maturity of the compliance team.
Experience required includes:
Essential
• Proven line management experience with a small compliance, audit or operational assurance team
• Demonstrable track record delivering an audit programme in a regulated industry (rail, bus, coach, logistics, aviation, utilities or similar)
• Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 (lead auditor qualification preferred — see Qualifications)
• Strong understanding of supplier assurance and contract compliance
• Confident with findings management, CAPA tracking and evidence discipline
• Clear, concise report writing for operational leadership
• Practical, daily user of enterprise AI tools (Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, Gemini or equivalent) for drafting audit narrative, summarising evidence, producing first-cut findings reports and MI commentary — with the judgement to verify and edit before release
• Responsible AI use: understands Arriva Group data classification and will not expose supplier PII, TOC-sensitive information or commercial data to unapproved tools
• Comfortable interrogating data directly — Excel to intermediate level, Power Query for cleaning, Power BI (or equivalent) for dashboards
• Ability to hold suppliers and internal colleagues to account without escalating unnecessarily
• Comfortable travelling nationally for supplier audits (typically 4–8 days per month)
Desirable
• Familiarity with PSVAR and DVSA-regulated operations
• Prior exposure to rail replacement, scheduled coach or taxi/PHV operations
• Experience in using a digital audit management system (e.g. iAuditor, Intelex, My Compliance, Ideagen Q-Pulse)
• Experience designing or scaling AI-assisted workflows in a compliance, audit or operations function
• Experience supporting a business through ISO surveillance or re-certification audits
• IEMA or environmental auditing awareness
• Formal training in responsible AI use, AI governance, or digital transformation
Behavioural Competencies
• Delivery-focused. Gets things done on time, chases closure, protects the audit schedule from drift.
• Evidence-led. Rely on facts, documents and traceable records rather than opinion or persuasion.
• Digitally curious and AI-literate. Looks for opportunities to use AI and digital tooling to lift audit quality and team productivity; treats AI output as a first draft, not a final answer.
• Fair and firm as a line manager. Develops the team, gives clear feedback, and does not avoid difficult conversations.
• Calm under challenge. Comfortable holding suppliers to account in audit settings without letting disagreement become personal.
• Collaborative. Works across Operations, Safety and Client-facing teams without creating friction.
• Ethical and independent-minded. Willing to flag issues that are commercially awkward when the evidence demands it, including emerging risks around AI-assisted work.

PATH current employees - please log in and apply Here
PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
About the role
PATH’s AI Initiative is pioneering the use of generative AI and other advanced digital technologies to accelerate biomedical discovery, strengthen regulatory systems, and enhance the safety and scalability of digital healthcare. Working under the supervision of the Deputy Director (AI4Science), the Senior AI Fellow will be a key member of the AI Initiative. This role has been created specifically to bring AI methods directly into PATH’s Center for Vaccine Innovation and Access (CVIA) science and operations, a world-leading division of PATH that has helped develop and introduce more than two dozen vaccines over the past three decades.
PATH’s Center for Vaccine Innovation and Access (CVIA) brings together our expertise across every stage of the long and complex process of vaccine research, development, and delivery to make lifesaving vaccines widely available to children and communities across the world. CVIA’s current portfolio encompasses more than two dozen vaccines either in development or already in use to protect against fifteen different diseases. Our focus is on vaccines to address the leading diseases that claim children’s lives worldwide: pneumonia, diarrheal disease, and malaria; as well as other global health priorities, such as polio and meningitis. We work in partnership with national health ministries, pharmaceutical manufacturers, donors, international financing and regulatory organizations, and many others. PATH has led numerous global partnerships, including the award-winning Meningitis Vaccine Project and the Malaria Vaccine Initiative, which helped develop the first malaria vaccine candidate recommended for pilot implementation.
The Senior AI Fellow will spend most of their time embedded in CVIA’s work, while remaining a full member of the AI Initiative team, with access to an established technical and thought-leading community, shared methods and infrastructure, and direct support for their growth as a global health AI practitioner and scientist.
Candidate Profile
The Senior AI Fellow will have a strong computational or quantitative background with demonstrated experience in vaccine development. While they might not have formally trained as an immunologist or vaccinologist, they will have spent enough time working in this space to understand how vaccines move from discovery through to market.
The core of their day-to-day work will be applying AI and computational methods to CVIA’s research and operational questions within agreed priorities and technical direction. This could include drawing on CVIA’s trial design and level-of-effort data to support estimation and planning tools, applying AI methods to chemistry, manufacturing, and controls challenges such as formulation or process optimization, or supporting operational decisions where CVIA’s institutional experience is the key asset and AI helps make it more usable.
It could also include agentic AI workflows to support the identification of novel correlates of protection, AI Co-Scientist tools applied to antigen design and selection, or support for analyzing immunogenicity and trial data. These are deep research problems tackled with scientific rigor and methodological ambition, using data ranging from operational to biological.
This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of AI and vaccine science and operations. The role may suit a vaccine scientist with hands-on fluency in modern AI systems or a computer scientist with experience in biomedical research. If you want to apply frontier AI to real global health challenges, as part of a team that has taken vaccines from the lab to the people who need them, this could be the role for you.
Please apply by Sunday, November 1, 2026 end of day for priority consideration.
Core Responsibilities
Solution Design and Scoping
• Serve as a trusted, day-to-day technical resource for the Deputy Director and CVIA colleagues on what AI and computational tools can and cannot usefully do.
• Work with colleagues, from senior leadership to bench scientists, to assess and recommend which problems are well suited to AI-assisted approaches, using agreed criteria and with guidance on priorities and final direction.
• For agreed use cases, develop and propose the technical approach, success measures, identification of available or required data and domain expertise, and development of a realistic project plan.
Product Development
• Apply rigorous quantitative research methods, including machine learning and statistical analysis, alongside AI methods such as prompt engineering and agent architecture design, to develop robust solutions for operational and scientific use cases within the CVIA portfolio.
• Build and iterate on AI-enabled tools and workflows that address defined CVIA needs, from predictive models for trial planning using CVIA’s historical data, to machine learning applied to CMC challenges such as formulation optimization, to LLM-based pipelines for evidence synthesis.
• Independently deliver assigned technical workstreams within agreed objectives, scope, methodology, and review points, from data exploration through production of a working tool or analysis.
• Use Python-based development, LLM APIs, agentic frameworks, and close collaboration with CVIA subject-matter experts who provide domain knowledge and validation.
Applied Analysis and Research
• Contribute to ongoing AI-related work across the CVIA portfolio, spanning operational improvement and scientific discovery. Current examples include using LLMs for evidence synthesis, leveraging AI Co-Scientist tools to support work on correlates of protection and trial data analysis, and using human-centered design principles to develop a wireframe for an agentic workflow that can generate regulatory strategies.
• Pair computational skills with the domain expertise of CVIA scientists and lead or contribute to publishable outputs where the results warrant it.
• Proactively identify and propose new use cases as CVIA’s priorities evolve, for consideration and prioritization by the Deputy Director and relevant CVIA leadership.
Secondary Responsibilities
Business Development
• Support business development activities at the intersection of AI and vaccine innovation and access, under the supervision of the relevant CVIA and AI team leadership.
• Provide technical input to CVIA staff considering opportunities that could leverage AI, including drafting technical contributions for proposals, reviewing AI-relevant proposal components, and supporting the identification of partners or solutions.

Here’s the Gist:
Wolfspeed is seeking a Commodity Manager (CM) to join the Business Support Services team within Procurement. This individual contributor position is a strong fit for an experienced indirect procurement professional who takes initiative, thrives on complexity, and moves work forward through influence rather than authority.
The CM will serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for procurement of Professional Services (PS), Consulting, Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Staff Augmentation, and will interact with a broad cross-section of the organization. This individual will facilitate the supplier selection process, ensure alignment between supplier deliverables and business needs, and provide the structure and momentum that stakeholders rely on, including bringing clarity to engagements where the path forward requires definition.
The Day-to-Day:
Most work in this role begins with a request from the business: a need to address, a sourcing activity to manage, or a specific task to complete (e.g., onboarding a new supplier). The CM engages with the requesting stakeholder, draws on an understanding of Wolfspeed's needs and current market conditions, and drives the work to resolution.
In parallel, the CM will approach the Professional Services commodity holistically to:
• Create sourcing strategies that address pain points and optimize the supply base for Wolfspeed.
• Identify strategic suppliers and cultivate relationships to position Wolfspeed as a preferred customer.
• Support compliance with procurement policies and processes, drawing on tools such as supplier scorecards, business reviews, and Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) methodology as appropriate.
• Identify and pursue cost avoidance and cost reduction opportunities in support of Wolfspeed's savings targets, tracking and communicating progress through established reporting methodology.
• Support a culture of procurement accountability across the organization, meeting stakeholders where they are while maintaining consistent expectations and standards.
Within the assigned commodities, the CM will own and manage the Requests for Information, Quote, or Proposal (RFI, RFQ, RFP, or collectively, RFX) process from start to finish.
The CM serves as the primary facilitator across the full contract lifecycle for PS agreements, most commonly Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Statements of Work (SOWs). This includes owning commercial terms review, proposing and negotiating revisions to benefit Wolfspeed, soliciting and integrating input from stakeholders and Legal, coordinating with suppliers, managing timelines, and overseeing renewals and expirations.
The successful CM brings a toolbox of communication skills that includes responsiveness, professionalism, accountability, clarity, relationship building, persuasion, empathy, and patience. In practice, this means:
• Building credibility and trust at all levels of the organization
• Presenting to senior leadership with confidence and clarity
• Striking the right balance between discourse, persuasion, and consensus
• Managing ambiguity and change while strengthening stakeholder relationships
• Driving stakeholder accountability through influence rather than authority
• Tailoring delivery and message to each audience
This Job is Right for You if You Have (Minimum Requirements):
All of these:
• A BS or BA in an analytical field of study, or equivalent work experience demonstrating analytical and negotiation skills.
• Five (5) or more years of Procurement, Sourcing, or Contract Management experience focused on Professional Services (buyer’s perspective) or equivalent Customer Service or Contract Management experience on the supplier side within BPO, Managed Service Provider (MSP), or staffing environments.
• Resilience, genuine comfort with change, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.
• An ingrained desire to help others succeed and a drive to encourage those around you.
• Demonstrated experience working effectively on a team with multiple competing priorities.
• Personal commitment to fair and ethical business practices, including the ability to earn trust across all levels of the organization.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to self-manage complex workloads, changing priorities, and competing deadlines.
• Ability to advocate for and negotiate on behalf of Wolfspeed, including in situations where the final decision rests with others.
At least two of these:
• Experience managing the full RFX process, either as the buyer developing and issuing solicitations or as a supplier responding to them, specifically in a PS context.
• Working knowledge of SAP Business Network (formerly Ariba).
• Familiarity with contract language common to PS engagements, including provisions for commercial terms and intellectual property ownership.
Highly Preferred:
Any of these:
• Demonstrated success (3+ years) in directly negotiating any combination of Consulting Agreements, Staff Augmentation Agreements, Master Service Agreements (MSAs) with Statements of Work (SOWs), and Engagement Letters.
• Proven success negotiating one or more large BPO contracts and managing the resulting engagement from the customer or buyer perspective.
• Successful experience working within or alongside an MSP program for contingent workforce or staff augmentation engagements from either the buyer or supplier side.

Job Description Summary
The Medical Monitor, Clinical Development is responsible for providing day‑to‑day medical oversight for one or more clinical trials to ensure patient safety, data integrity, and protocol compliance throughout trial execution. This role serves as the primary medical point of contact for study teams and clinical sites, supporting safe and compliant study conduct in alignment with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and regulatory requirements.
Operating within defined protocols and development strategies, the Medical Monitor provides medical judgment during trial execution, including safety signal evaluation, eligibility assessments, dose modifications, and risk mitigation. The role works closely with Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, Data Management, Biostatistics, and Regulatory Affairs to support operational excellence, timely issue resolution, and high‑quality clinical data.
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
Le Médecin Moniteur (Medical Monitor), Développement Clinique est responsable de la supervision médicale quotidienne d’un ou de plusieurs essais cliniques afin de garantir la sécurité des patients, l’intégrité des données et la conformité au protocole tout au long de l’exécution de l’étude. Ce poste constitue le principal point de contact médical pour les équipes de l’étude et les sites cliniques, en veillant à ce que les études soient menées de manière sûre et conforme aux Bonnes Pratiques Cliniques (BPC/GCP) ainsi qu’aux exigences réglementaires.
Dans le cadre de protocoles définis et de stratégies de développement établies, le Médecin Moniteur apporte son jugement médical durant l’exécution des essais, notamment pour l’évaluation des signaux de sécurité, l’examen de l’éligibilité des participants, les ajustements de doses et les mesures d’atténuation des risques. Le titulaire du poste travaille en étroite collaboration avec les équipes des Opérations Cliniques, de Pharmacovigilance, de Gestion des Données, de Biostatistiques et des Affaires Réglementaires afin de soutenir l’excellence opérationnelle, la résolution rapide des problèmes et la production de données cliniques de haute qualité.
GE HealthCare est un leader mondial des technologies médicales et des solutions numériques innovantes. Notre mission est de créer un monde où les soins de santé n’ont aucune limite. Libérez votre ambition, transformez vos idées en réalités capables de changer le monde et rejoignez une organisation où chaque voix compte et où chaque contribution participe à bâtir un monde en meilleure santé.

Clinical Trial Medical Oversight
•
Provide medical oversight for one or more assigned clinical trials within a program or portfolio.
•
Ensure patient safety and protocol‑compliant execution throughout trial conduct.
•
Apply medical judgment to eligibility questions, protocol deviations, dosing decisions, and participant risk mitigation.
Safety Monitoring & Signal Detection
•
Review and assess AEs and SAEs, including causality and severity evaluations.
•
Participate in ongoing safety reviews, internal safety committees, and Data Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMBs) as required.
•
Collaborate closely with Pharmacovigilance to support safety signal detection, escalation, and risk‑management actions.
•
Support development and implementation of protocol amendments or safety measures when indicated.

•
Serve as a key medical contact for investigators, responding to protocol‑specific medical questions and eligibility clarifications.
•
Support investigator meetings and site engagement activities with study‑specific medical input.
•
Provide medical oversight and guidance when studies are conducted with CRO medical monitors, ensuring consistency with GE HealthCare expectations.
Cross‑Functional Study Team Collaboration
•
Work closely with Clinical Trial Leads (CTLs), Clinical Project Managers (CPMs), CRAs, Data Management, and Biostatistics to support smooth trial execution.

Participate in operational safety and study management meetings, contributing medical perspective to study‑level decisions.

Support timely identification and resolution of safety or operational risks impacting study conduct.

Contribute to clinical study reports (CSRs), safety narratives, and regulatory submission documents.

Ensure accuracy and consistency of medical data in study documentation and regulatory deliverables.

MD or equivalent medical degree.

3–7 years of experience in clinical trial execution, medical monitoring, or related roles.

Strong knowledge of GCP, clinical trial conduct, and safety reporting requirements.
•
Experience reviewing AEs/SAEs and participating in safety oversight activities.
•
Ability to work within protocol and regulatory frameworks while applying sound medical judgment.

•
Strong clinical judgment with attention to patient safety and data quality.
•
Solid understanding of clinical trial methodology and operational execution.
•
Ability to collaborate effectively within cross‑functional and matrixed teams.
•
Clear and professional communication with investigators and study stakeholders.
•
Detail‑oriented, with strong documentation and compliance mindset.
Principales responsabilités
Supervision médicale des essais cliniques

Assurer la supervision médicale d’un ou de plusieurs essais cliniques attribués au sein d’un programme ou d’un portefeuille d’études.

Garantir la sécurité des patients et une exécution conforme au protocole tout au long de la conduite des essais.

Appliquer son jugement médical aux questions d’éligibilité, aux écarts de protocole, aux décisions de dosage et aux mesures de réduction des risques pour les participants.

Examiner et évaluer les événements indésirables (AE) et les événements indésirables graves (SAE), y compris les analyses de causalité et de gravité.

Participer aux revues de sécurité continues, aux comités internes de sécurité et aux Comités de Surveillance de la Sécurité des Données (Data Safety Monitoring Boards - DSMB), selon les besoins.

Collaborer étroitement avec la Pharmacovigilance pour soutenir la détection des signaux de sécurité, leur escalade et les actions de gestion des risques.

Soutenir l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre d’amendements au protocole ou de mesures de sécurité lorsque cela est nécessaire.

Job Description:
Craft Apprenticeship - Surface Finish Fitter
Start date: September 2027
Location: Broughton
Duration: 36 months

Work-life balance is important, with a 35-hour week on either a standard working day or a double-day shift pattern, providing flexibility.
About us
Ready to build the wings that lift the world? Join Airbus as a Craft Surface finish Apprentice in Airbus Broughton and play a vital role in manufacturing wings for our A320, A330, and A350 aircraft families. This 36-month program offers valuable hands-on training, recognised qualifications, and a clear path to a rewarding career in aviation."
At Airbus, we believe a diverse workforce drives innovation. We're committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive.  Airbus is a global pioneer in the aerospace industry, leading the way in designing, manufacturing, and delivering aerospace products across Commercial Aircraft, Helicopters, Defence, and Space sectors. As the global center of excellence for wing manufacturing, our Broughton site delivers over 500 wing sets annually. Our apprenticeship programs are carefully designed to give you valuable practical training alongside your academic studies, setting you up for success and helping your career truly fly.
With over 17,5000 employees worldwide and as the largest aeronautics and space company in Europe, Airbus is at the forefront of the aviation industry. During your apprenticeship you will work alongside our experienced engineers and quality team to support you to complete the work safely and efficiently
What you will be doing
As a Craft Surface Finish Fitting apprentice you’ll immerse yourself for the  first 12 months of the programme  learning the foundational skills required in the preparation and application of surface finishes. While completing your academic studies the course will also cover an element of mechanical fitting activities. This program is designed to equip you with valuable qualifications and competencies to work directly on live aircraft. You'll also benefit from our Gen A support network and learning HUB, providing additional support, events, and opportunities for all early career participants.
This 36-month apprenticeship is structured to maximise your learning and impact:
Year One: You will spend the first 12  months of your apprenticeship based at Rhyl College, working towards obtaining:
•
NVQ Level 2 diploma in Performing Engineering Operations;
•
Level 2 Academic Qualification
•
Level 2 Essential Skills;
This will allow you to develop the necessary skills, knowledge and experience to enable you to make an immediate contribution when you enter the workforce in the second year.
Year 2 and 3:  Your Learning Takes Flight at Broughton! Building on your foundational knowledge, you'll join our world-class team at the Airbus Broughton site in North Wales. Here, you'll apply your skills directly to live aircraft projects and assist in the preparation and painting of the wings for our Single Aisle and Wide body families. Your varied tasks will require a range of technical skills. This will include:
•
Preparation & Setup: This involves meticulously cleaning, sanding, and masking surfaces to ensure proper adhesion and a flawless finish. It also includes accurately mixing paints and preparing spray equipment according to specifications.
•
Application & Quality: Skillfully applying multiple, even coats of paint using precise techniques, while monitoring environmental conditions. A crucial part of the role is inspecting the finish for quality, making adjustments, and performing touch-ups, all while strictly adhering to safety protocols and equipment maintenance.
•
Fitting Activities - This would include a placement in our single aisle and wide body business areas to perform fitting activities in our wingbox production areas, these activities will include drilling and installing fasteners.
You'll continue your academic studies on day release, working towards:
•
Level 3 NVQ Extended Diploma (Aeronautical Engineering)
•
Level 3 Academic Certificate
Upon successful completion of your 38-month apprenticeship, you'll become a skilled Surface finish Fitter, specialising in the preparation and application of surface finishes plus the ability to drill-off and assembly of both metallic and composite components to produce the wing box structure on our world-class Airbus aircraft. You'll receive a Modern Apprenticeship Certificate, setting you up for a fantastic career.
Requirements
To be eligible, you must achieve a minimum of 5 GCSEs (Grade C or 4), including: Maths, English Language, Double Award Science (Grade CC/ 44) OR Single award in Physics (C/4) plus 2 additional GCSEs (other equivalent or higher qualifications may be considered)
To be a successful candidate you need to:
•
Have a passion for learning, enjoy hands-on, teamwork and problem solving activities
•
Include your CV stating your predicted or achieved grades in your application;
•
Include your Cover Letter stating your motivation for this role in your application.
Important Information:
GRADES:  Please note: Any offer will be conditional upon us receiving evidence of your required grades by August 31, 2027, in addition to completing all pre-employment checks and online forms.
RIGHT TO WORK IN THE UK: Candidates must have current legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom. For more information, please check the Government Website.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• A friendly, approachable and can-do attitude.

Clinical experience within speciality – Tissue viability, safe mobility and falls prevention.

Consequently, we currently have an exciting opportunity for a senior grade engineer to join our mine waste team in Nottingham.

• Stay curious about emerging tools and share relevant, practical ideas that could improve People Operations.

• Review workflows, case themes, employee feedback and available service data to identify root causes and improvement opportunities.

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
Senior Commercial Forecasting Analyst – UK
Meet the team:
Join Dexcom's EMEA Commercial Forecasting & Analytics team and act as a strategic business partner to commercial leadership, providing data-driven forecasts and insights that inform key business decisions and shape how we bring life-changing diabetes technology to patients.
The numbers we put together don't just sit in a spreadsheet — they guide decisions across the business, from commercial planning and marketing to supply chain and investor relations. You will be working directly with senior leaders from day one, connecting the dots between strategy, insights and market trends, and turning them into a clear direction the business can act on.
If you enjoy understanding how markets evolve, solving complex business problems and translating uncertainty into actionable forecasts, you will feel right at home here.
Where you come in:
As Senior Commercial Forecasting Analyst, you’ll play a central role in leading both short-term and long-term revenue forecasting for Dexcom’s portfolio working closely with commercial teams, market access, operations and supply chain. You will be responsible for:
• Acting as a strategic partner for commercial leaders, providing insights and recommendations that support the identification of growth opportunities and risks, helping to shape the direction of the business
• Owning the quarterly revenue forecasting process and supporting the long-range planning (LRP) cycle across multiple regions
• Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (analytics, pricing, commercial, marketing, market access…) to assess opportunities and risks, define robust forecast assumptions and align forecasts with strategic goals
• Presenting forecast assumptions and results to senior leadership, using clear, compelling and well-structured presentations and visualisations
• Leverage data to identify trends, growth drivers, and emerging risks, translating them into actionable insights that strengthen forecast quality and business planning
• Performing variance analysis to identify key performance drivers, explain changes versus expectations, and highlight emerging risks and opportunities
• Building scalable forecasting models and scenarios that help the business understand the impact of market dynamics and strategic decisions
• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting processes and methodologies to enhance business value, increase efficiency, and support the continued growth of the organisation

You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:
• Previous experience in Commercial Forecasting, Management Consulting, Commercial Analytics, FP&A, Business Planning, or a similar analytical or commercial function
• Strong business and commercial acumen, with the ability to understand market dynamics, identify growth opportunities and risks, and translate them into business recommendations
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to combine data, insights, and business priorities to support decision-making
• Excellent communication or storytelling skills in English, with the ability to present complex topics clearly and confidently to a range of stakeholders, including senior leadership
• A collaborative mindset. You are a team player with proven ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders, and work effectively across functions
• Experience building and maintain logical, scalable models in Excel
• Familiarity with VBA or other programming languages (e.g., SQL, R, Python, etc.) is an advantage, as well as accessing large data sets via Google BigQuery and Amazon Redshift
• Proactive and adaptable, comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, with a growth mindset and a continuous focus on improvement and value creation
Nice to have
• Additional European languages such as German, Spanish, or French
• Familiarity with visualisation tools like Tableau or similar
• Experience in healthcare, medtech, pharmaceuticals, consulting, commercial operations, or related industries
What you’ll get:
• A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
• A full and comprehensive benefits program.
• Growth opportunities on a global scale.
• Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
• An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.
